_help: Defaults. Your changes go to config.json (created on first start). play_per_study = minutes of play for 1 minute of study.
_help_kickstart: The first kickstart_min minutes of study PER DAY are multiplied by kickstart_multiplier.
_help_finish: When a game must close (curfew / time up), a 'Finish match' offer shows for finish_prompt_sec seconds: max finish_match_min minutes, finish_match_per_day times a day. Borrowed minutes are taken from tomorrow.
_help_games: Games: steam_auto = every game in Steam libraries. Add others in Settings (or here): game_exe = exe names, game_roots = folders, java_keywords = words in a Java command line (e.g. minecraft).
_help_whitelist: Never closed: whitelist_exe = exe names, whitelist_name_contains = text in the exe name, whitelist_dirs = folder names inside steamapps\common that are tools, not games.
